notes.title: Shields Up'date'
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you for playing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1454650/Kanso/]Kanso[/url][/h1]
I hope it continues to bring you much joy and relaxation.

In this update:
[list]
[*]  Upgraded touch control system
[*]  New health system
[*]  Upgraded controller control system
[*]  Fixed small bugs
[*]  Performance optimisations
[/list]
In an ongoing effort to balance Kanso as well as possible I have reworked the controls, fixed some quirks and made it all feel more pleasant. 
Also!
Kanso now has shields that you can pick up along an enzô.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39078097/730e8d357d9fd909d33afce663b2ecbf96680484.gif[/img]

Only on difficult levels, there are now points of light you can pick up that generate a protective shield.  This allows you to collide with daemons but still complete your circle.  
Be aware, doing so will result in an imperfect completion. This will show up for each level as a black enzô in the level select worlds.
To get a white enzô completion state you but complete the level with NO collisions. 
A perfect circle.

notes.title: New Levels
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39078097/91331c87d40abeca58429bfd001444eb7d1006bc.png[/img]
After much consideration I have reworked the 32 levels in the Foundation world.  The first world you encounter after the first 'Root' levels.

I initially intended these Ensô's (Levels) to be empty, a moment to focus on the circular motion of Kanso.
While I feel this works conceptually, it left some players understandably a little confused on why there was no Daemons to avoid.

So with that in mind I designed a set of levels that keeps in line with my intentions and also offers the same light challenge as the rest of Kanso.

I hope you enjoy this addition to Kanso, and that it helps you fine your moment of Zen.

notes.title: Accessibility Mode
notes.content:
Added in this update is the new accessible way to play Kanso.
Simply press and hold a direction on your D-pad or Arrow keys.  And you will start on the corresponding position on an ensō.
Keep holding the key and you will glide round each of the shapes, press two directions to slow your progress and avoid the Daemons.

notes.title: Kanso Early Access Release
notes.content:
[h2]Now live on Early Access.
[/h2]
Come join me in my journey to complete Kanso and find a relaxing place to let the world melt away.
This is a low stress, minimal challenge, and soothing game. 
[h2][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1454650/Kanso/]Get Kanso now[/url][/b][/h2]

[h2]Zen[/h2]
Inspired by the Zen calligraphy practice of [b]Ensô[/b], where every day you paint an uninhibited ink circle on a blank sheet of paper.  
Expressing a physical moment of reflection, focus, and freedom of [b]flow[/b].  
As you move around the circular forms, avoiding the Koi like [b]Daemons[/b].   Kanso is carefully balanced to invoke the flow of this calligraphic practice as a unique gameplay experience.
